paragraphs.text: Uriah Aswark was the captain of the Grand Master of the Arena's fighters, in the city of Estark on Dominaria . A former member of Oor-tael, he betrayed his house in the Night of Fire , the destruction of the House of Oor-tael .
Uriah was born hunchbacked but with the ability to control mana. He was friends with a potion master from whom he purchased drugs he used to rape noblewomen.

Uriah was a member of Oor-tael for years. He betrayed his house by feeding information to Zarel Ewine and unbarring the house's gate on the Night of Fire . He was rewarded by becoming the captain of the Grand Master's fighters. During the battle in the Great Plaza at the end of the Time of Troubles , he killed Tulan . When Garth returned to fight Zarel, Uriah stabbed the Grand Master in the back before being stabbed in the heart.
